description: Profitbase Gantt Chart is a Power BI gantt visual for project management, project schedule reporting, and PMO dashboards. Display projects, tasks, milestones, and dependencies on an interactive project timeline so stakeholders across your organization can stay aligned on delivery. Use the Profitbase Gantt Chart for project timeline visualization, milestone tracking, baseline comparison, planned vs actual, schedule reporting, and portfolio oversight - directly inside Power BI. Used by several large energy companies for use cases such as integrated operational planning and offshore maintenance scheduling. Main features: Project hierarchy: unlimited levels with per-level formatting, ragged hierarchy support, and configurable expansion styles Baselines: planned start/end dates rendered alongside actual bars for planned-vs-actual schedule analysis Task dependencies: draw connector lines between tasks and configure dependency offset (lag/lead time) Milestones: display multiple milestones per task row by adding date fields to the milestone bucket Dynamic event markers: add event markers driven automatically from your data Progress tracking: render % complete on every task bar Today line showing the current date across the project timeline Days off and non-working periods rendered on the timeline (weekends, holidays, shutdowns) Event markers and event ranges: highlighting curtains for…
